e3e0d154a699a357.description: We are looking for an Outbound Officer to join our Supply Chain Operations team at Ninja. In this role, you will verify outbound orders, prepare dispatch documents, and coordinate with the warehouse and transportation teams to ensure orders are loaded onto the correct vehicles and dispatched with the required approvals. Responsibilities Process outbound orders based on dispatch priorities and verify order references, quantities, and route or store details before release. Update order status and confirm required transactions in the Warehouse Management System (WMS). Prepare and verify dispatch documents, manifests, and labels. Keep accurate records of dispatched orders and handovers. Check that orders are staged in the correct areas and support loading checks to match each order to its assigned vehicle. Identify missing, damaged, incomplete, or misrouted orders. Coordinate corrections with the relevant teams and escalate issues that could delay dispatch. Hold orders when required documents or approvals are missing, and follow up on pending orders until the issue is resolved. Follow warehouse safety, product handling, and temperature-control procedures where applicable. Report hazards, damage, or incidents in the loading area. 0–3 years of relevant experience in warehouse operations, logistics, transportation, inventory, or operational support. Fresh graduates with a relevant qualification are welcome to apply. Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Ability to use Microsoft Excel and relevant warehouse or operations systems, such as WMS or ERP. Strong attention to detail, communication, problem-solving, and follow-up skills. Ability to coordinate with different teams in a high-volume distribution center. Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, public holidays, or extended hours as needed. ASCM CLTD or a relevant logistics or transportation certification is a plus. Training in WMS, TMS, fleet management, or transport safety is also an advantage.

e327dbc221a0375a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أباريل للتجارة عن مدير متجر للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على الأهداف التشغيلية للمتجر، وتخطيط وتنظيم وإدارة العمليات اليومية لضمان الكفاءة والفعالية القصوى. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على وضع الأهداف والخطط التشغيلية للمتجر، وتطوير وتنسيق الإجراءات التشغيلية للموظفين. تحديد المهام والمسؤوليات الموكلة للموظفين وتوزيعها عليهم لضمان سير العمل بفعالية. متابعة الأنشطة اليومية للمتجر والتأكد من توفير الدعم والمعلومات اللازمة لفرق العمل. ضمان توفر الموارد اللازمة لتنفيذ الأنشطة اليومية وملاءمتها لمعايير الجودة المعتمدة. مراقبة مستويات وكميات السلع والبضائع في المتجر والتنسيق مع الجهات المعنية لتنفيذ طلبات الشراء. التأكد من التزام الموظفين بالتوجيهات والمهام المسندة إليهم وأدائهم لها بفعالية. ضمان تنفيذ كافة الأنظمة والقرارات المتعلقة بإدارة المتجر والتواصل مع الموظفين لتعزيز فهمهم للمستجدات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في إدارة المتاجر أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على وضع الأهداف التشغيلية وتطوير الخطط الاستراتيجية. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم والإدارة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل مدير المتجر ضمن فريق ديناميكي لضمان تحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية للمتجر. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

e32a601e54a8c35b.description: About the Role WSP is seeking an experienced Associate or Associate Director for Bridges & Tunnels to join its Transport & Infrastructure design team. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and involves a senior technical and design leadership role in delivering complex bridges, tunnels, and transportation structures across the region. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership throughout the design lifecycle, from feasibility and concept design through preliminary and detailed design, design review, and construction-stage technical support. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the design of bridges, tunnels, and associated transportation structures, ensuring solutions are technically robust, buildable, economical, and appropriate for the local environment. Provide technical leadership across concept, preliminary, and detailed design stages, including structural analysis, design development, verification, and technical reviews. Review and approve engineering calculations, design reports, drawings, specifications, and other technical deliverables. Ensure designs comply with applicable Saudi Arabian requirements and recognized international design standards and codes. Lead Bridges & Tunnels packages on major multidisciplinary infrastructure projects, establishing design programs, deliverables, resources, and technical responsibilities. Manage design changes and identify technical, program, and commercial risks, supporting the resolution of complex design and interface issues. Lead, manage, and mentor engineers and designers within the Bridges & Tunnels team, providing technical guidance and supporting succession planning. Develop strong relationships with clients, authorities, and project stakeholders, representing WSP at technical workshops and client meetings. For the Associate Director level, responsibilities also include a stronger focus on client relationships, commercial performance, strategic team development, and identifying future opportunities. Qualifications and Experience For Associate level: 15+ years of relevant engineering experience, predominantly in bridge, tunnel, or transportation structures design. For Associate Director level: 20+ years of relevant experience, including significant technical/design leadership responsibilities. Strong experience within an engineering consultancy/design environment, with proven delivery of major bridge, tunnel, and/or transportation structure design projects. Strong understanding of structural engineering principles covering reinforced concrete, prestressed concrete, and steel structures. Experience in the design of structures such as highway bridges, interchanges, underpasses, cut-and-cover structures, and tunnels. Ability to lead multidisciplinary design coordination and resolve complex interfaces. Strong understanding of design assurance, independent checking, and technical governance processes. Experience managing engineering teams and coordinating resources across multiple projects. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence to engage senior clients and stakeholders. Previous experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider Middle East is highly desirable. Technical Capabilities Strong knowledge of relevant bridge and structural design tools such as MIDAS, RM Bridge, SOFiSTiK, LUSAS, PLAXIS, or equivalent packages. Experience should ideally include structural analysis and finite element modeling, bridge and transportation structure design, reinforced and prestressed concrete design, and steel structure design. Proficiency in foundations and soil-structure interaction, seismic and dynamic design considerations, and design of underground and retaining structures. Experience in design review and independent checking, as well as BIM/digital engineering environments and multidisciplinary model coordination. Commercial and Business Development Particularly at the Associate Director level, this role involves supporting the growth of WSP's Bridges & Tunnels capability within Saudi Arabia. This includes identifying opportunities with existing and prospective clients, supporting and leading technical inputs into bids and proposals, and contributing to fee estimates and resource plans. The role also monitors project financial performance and assists in developing the longer-term strategy and capability of the Bridges & Tunnels team. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this role within WSP's Transport & Infrastructure design team.

e398552c14f7c0fc.description: About Whitecollars Whitecollars is recruiting on behalf of a growing luxury interior design and construction company based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This company specializes in bringing distinctive spaces to life for corporate and private clients, managing projects from initial concept and design through to project management, construction, and final delivery. Role Overview The Business Development Project Manager (Event and Exhibition) will serve as a strategic and operational leader responsible for launching, establishing, and scaling the Events & Exhibitions department. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, involves reporting directly to executive leadership and driving business growth by navigating tender platforms, expanding high-value client networks across Saudi Arabia, and overseeing projects from initial pricing and BOQ preparation to on-site execution and financial closure. The role requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Monitor tender platforms such as Etimad/Manafesat and prepare technical and financial proposals. Expand the client network across Saudi Arabia. Prepare detailed Bills of Quantities (BOQs), manage project budgets, and negotiate with suppliers to safeguard profit margins. Oversee end-to-end project execution, including scheduling, site setup, permit acquisition, subcontractor management, installation, and final handover. Recruit and mentor team members, establish departmental workflows, and achieve annual revenue targets. Required Qualifications and Experience Sales and Business Development: Proven experience in identifying prospects, building client relationships, and converting leads into business opportunities. B2B experience, particularly in selling products or services to companies and navigating multi-stakeholder purchasing decisions, is preferred. Communication and Opportunity Generation: Ability to confidently approach potential clients, understand their needs, present relevant solutions, and negotiate effectively. This includes creating new business opportunities through outreach, networking, referrals, and consistent follow-up. Saudi Market Knowledge: Familiarity with Saudi Arabia’s construction, events, and luxury projects sectors, including key players, client expectations, and procurement practices. Understanding how to identify upcoming projects and connect with relevant decision-makers is valuable. Established Network: Strong existing relationships with government entities and large corporate clients in KSA, with the ability to engage key stakeholders, identify project opportunities, and build long-term partnerships. Commercial and Technical Expertise: Demonstrated experience in pricing Bills of Quantities (BOQs), preparing and managing bids, and interpreting technical drawings. The ability to translate project requirements into accurate cost estimates and well-structured proposals is essential. Compensation and Benefits The position offers a competitive basic salary along with an attractive percentage of project profits. Additional benefits include housing and transportation allowances, medical insurance for the employee and family, and annual flight tickets. The role also provides full operational authority to build a team and shape department strategy.

e3ccbad85f1d6aa0.description: About the Role Taj HR is seeking a skilled and hands-on IT Technician to provide technical support across various IT systems. This full-time role involves supporting desktop systems, hardware, software, and network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will possess strong troubleshooting skills and a solid understanding of system integration, particularly concerning Oracle NetSuite and ZenHR. Key Responsibilities Provide desktop and laptop support, including hardware diagnostics, troubleshooting, software installation, and peripheral configuration. Diagnose and resolve technical issues related to Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications, and end-user devices. Troubleshoot network connectivity issues involving LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and Wi-Fi. Support system integration activities, specifically connecting Oracle NetSuite with ZenHR, and assist in troubleshooting related integration issues. Monitor and resolve IT incidents independently within the assigned scope, escalating complex issues when necessary. Maintain accurate documentation of technical issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions. Provide technical assistance to employees and ensure reliable day-to-day IT operations. Coordinate with relevant teams and service providers to resolve technical issues and maintain system functionality. Qualifications and Experience At least 2 to 5 years of relevant IT support or IT technician experience is preferred. Strong practical knowledge of desktop support, hardware and software troubleshooting, and Windows operating systems. Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and common business applications. Practical understanding of networking fundamentals, including LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and Wi-Fi. Good understanding of system integration concepts, with the ability to support integrations between business systems such as NetSuite and ZenHR. Required Skills Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken. Ability to work independently, manage technical incidents, and communicate effectively with end users. Additional Information Work visa sponsorship is available for eligible candidates applying from outside Saudi Arabia. Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

e31146341e93fda4.description: About the Role Taj Dhabi is seeking an experienced MEP Construction Manager to oversee and manage all Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) construction activities for large-scale projects in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on site execution, construction coordination, and subcontractor management to ensure timely completion of MEP installations in adherence to approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and safety requirements. The MEP Construction Manager will be crucial in coordinating MEP works with other disciplines to facilitate efficient construction progress and successful project delivery. Key Responsibilities Lead and supervise daily MEP construction activities, ensuring compliance with approved drawings, project specifications, and construction schedules. Oversee the installation and execution of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting, and associated building services systems. Develop and implement MEP construction execution plans, method statements, and site work schedules. Coordinate MEP works with civil, structural, architectural, façade, and other construction disciplines to resolve site interface issues. Manage MEP subcontractors, site engineers, supervisors, and construction teams to ensure efficient project execution. Monitor construction progress, manpower productivity, equipment utilization, and resource allocation. Review shop drawings, material submittals, technical documentation, and construction methodologies to ensure site readiness. Identify and resolve technical issues, installation conflicts, and construction coordination challenges. Coordinate with BIM teams to identify and resolve MEP clashes and construction interface conflicts. Ensure timely availability of materials, equipment, approved drawings, and required resources. Monitor subcontractor performance and ensure compliance with project milestones, quality requirements, and contractual obligations. Coordinate with Planning, Procurement, Engineering, QA/QC, HSE, and Commercial teams to support construction activities. Conduct site inspections and ensure compliance with approved installation procedures, quality standards, and safety regulations. Monitor construction progress against baseline schedules and implement corrective actions to address delays. Coordinate MEP testing, commissioning, inspections, and handover activities with relevant stakeholders. Attend site coordination meetings and provide regular construction progress reports to project management. Ensure MEP construction activities are completed within the approved schedule, budget, quality, and HSE requirements. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in MEP construction management. Demonstrated ability to manage and supervise MEP construction activities on large-scale projects. Strong understanding of MEP systems, construction processes, and project specifications. Proficiency in developing execution plans, method statements, and site work schedules. Experience in coordinating with various construction disciplines and managing subcontractors. Work Environment This role is primarily based at construction project sites, with coordination at corporate offices as required. The MEP Construction Manager will work in close collaboration with MEP teams, civil and structural engineers, architectural teams, BIM coordinators, subcontractors, consultants, and project management. The environment is fast-paced, supporting large-scale, complex, and high-profile construction projects across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

e31794fe5867a166.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن مراقب خدمات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على أعمال موظفي الخدمات العامة وتطوير إجراءات العمل لضمان الكفاءة والفعالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال ونشاطات موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتحديد مهامهم وواجباتهم بناءً على حجم وأولويات العمل وقدرات العاملين. إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل، وتنسيق النشاطات مع الوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى ذات العلاقة. دراسة مشكلات العمل، وتحديد أسبابها، واقتراح بدائل الحلول الممكنة، واختيار الحل الأنسب، ومتابعة التنفيذ والتقييم. تقييم أداء موظفي الخدمات العامة ومدى التزامهم باللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بمجال العمل. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية الفردية للموظفين وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الخدمات العامة أو الإشراف الإداري. القدرة على مراجعة وتنسيق الأنشطة وتحديد المهام بفعالية. مهارات في إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل. القدرة على تحليل المشكلات واقتراح الحلول المناسبة. مهارات تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في مدينة الطائف بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تقديم أفضل مستويات الخدمة والصيانة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل.

e323441b3b862613.description: About Roche At Roche, individuals are valued and respected, fostering an environment where personal and professional growth is supported. The company focuses on preventing, stopping, and curing diseases, ensuring access to healthcare for current and future generations. Roche is committed to an inclusive culture where every voice is heard. Role Overview Roche is seeking a Supply Chain Director for Roche Diagnostics Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and requires over 10 years of experience. The Supply Chain Director serves as a strategic business partner and a key member of both the Saudi Arabia Leadership Team (SALT) and the Middle East Supply Chain Leadership Team. This role involves shaping the end-to-end supply chain model to enhance commercial value, customer loyalty, and organizational resilience, extending beyond operational boundaries to drive the strategic agenda for both leadership teams. Key Responsibilities Contribute to and influence decision-making forums. Build consensus and coalitions to advance initiatives within a matrixed environment. Navigate complex stakeholder dynamics, balancing conflicting interests and translating organizational risks into strategic influence. Ensure transparent communication on strategic initiatives. Plan and implement the in-country supply chain strategy in alignment with regional and global objectives. Collaborate with internal teams, including chapters and networks. Establish and monitor key supply chain performance indicators (KPIs). Liaise with the integrated planning team to optimize inventory levels for spare parts, instruments, and reagents. Manage 3PL supply chain activities to ensure timely execution. Collaborate on automation and digitalization projects with relevant teams. Lead order management and warehousing teams to ensure efficient operations and on-time deliveries. Analyze customer feedback and develop improvement action plans. Shape supply chain models to support commercial growth and optimize inventory, translating data insights into strategic recommendations. Coordinate inbound, outbound, and returns processes with 3PL partners. Develop and monitor 3PL performance to meet Roche quality standards. Collaborate with 3PLs to resolve operational issues and implement improvements. Ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and Roche's ethical standards. Participate in warehouse quality and certification audits. Identify and address customer needs with clear information and resolve issues efficiently. Build and maintain positive customer relationships through active listening. Gather customer feedback to enhance products, services, and internal processes. Create a motivating environment to attract, engage, and retain talent. Hire, develop, and manage employees and third-party partners for local operations. Delegate tasks, foster team decision-making, and promote open communication. Provide regular feedback, coaching, and individual development plans for employees. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in supply chain management. Ability to act as a visionary and coach, influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority. Demonstrated capability to actively drive strategic agendas for both the Saudi Arabia Leadership Team (SALT) and the Middle East Supply Chain Leadership Team. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Join Roche to contribute to a mission focused on healthcare innovation and access.

e332d1ff966b7c6d.description: About the Role Accenture Middle East is seeking a Network Security Engineer to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with potential work in Jeddah. This full-time role involves the daily operation and support of network security services, ensuring the secure and reliable functioning of our network infrastructure and threat management solutions. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Operate and support Network Security tools, including Firewalls, Mail gateways, Proxies, and NAC solutions. Manage Firewall Policy Creation and Change Management, utilizing AlgoSec for policy reviews and validations. Administer and troubleshoot network security devices and platforms, ensuring secure configurations, availability, and performance in on-premises environments. Support troubleshooting of network and security issues, including traffic analysis and packet capture, to facilitate quick and effective resolutions. Support audit and reporting activities to provide transparency into network security operations. Escalate complex issues or potential threats as necessary for efficient and effective resolution. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or equivalent work experience. Strong understanding of network security protocols and concepts, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention, malware analysis, and threat detection. Hands-on experience with Firewalls, WAF, API Security, DDoS, IPS, Mail gateways, Proxies, and NAC solutions. Knowledge of on-premise environments, including secure configurations and operational management. Practical experience in network troubleshooting, including traffic analysis and packet capture techniques. Required Skills Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with a proactive and continuous improvement mindset. Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to support audits and generate actionable reports. Preferred Certifications Industry certifications such as CCNA Security, CCNP Security, PNSCE, NSE4, or NSE7 are highly desirable for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities that may extend to Jeddah. The role involves working within a team dedicated to maintaining robust network security for Accenture Middle East.

e37de6c45187eea4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بيت العرب الحديثة عن أخصائي جغرافيا للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة وتطبيق تقنيات نظم المعلومات الجغرافية (GIS) ضمن نطاق العقود المحددة. هذه فرصة للمتخصصين ذوي الخبرة الحديثة أو الخريجين الجدد للانضمام إلى بيئة عمل بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة أنظمة المعلومات الجغرافية (GIS) بكفاءة ضمن نطاق العقود الموكلة. تطبيق وتفعيل تكنولوجيا نظم المعلومات الجغرافية (GIS) لضمان سير العمليات بفعالية. العمل على تحليل البيانات الجغرافية وتقديم الدعم الفني اللازم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الجغرافيا أو نظم المعلومات الجغرافية. إلمام قوي بمفاهيم وتطبيقات نظم المعلومات الجغرافية (GIS). القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة نجران، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتوفر بيئة عمل داعمة تتيح للموظفين الجدد تطوير مهاراتهم في مجال الجغرافيا ونظم المعلومات الجغرافية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الفرصة في مجموعة بيت العرب الحديثة.

e3f2b3656752bdea.description: About the Role SAMI Airbus is seeking an Aircraft Maintenance Technician to join their team in Al Kharj, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves contributing to the optimal in-service support and maintenance of the RSAF A330 MRTT aircraft fleet, ensuring excellent fleet availability while upholding the highest quality and safety standards. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to support the MRO department in delivering effective maintenance solutions for the RSAF A330 MRTT aircraft fleet. The technician will play a crucial part in ensuring aircraft readiness and operational efficiency through diligent maintenance practices, adhering to stringent quality and safety protocols within the RSAF environment. Key Responsibilities Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance on the MRTT fleet, ensuring timely completion, cost-effectiveness, and adherence to quality and safety requirements. Undertake daily preventive, corrective, servicing, and routine maintenance tasks necessary for aircraft release to fly, either individually or as part of a team. As a B2 – Avionics technician, inspect, maintain, operate, repair, troubleshoot, and service the following aircraft systems: Automatic Flight Control Communications Electrical Power Indication Navigation Complete assigned duties from the Team/Shift Leader, ensuring all work meets ADSAS Maintenance Organization's delivery quality and safety standards. Document all performed work on appropriate paperwork or documents, including required signatures, in accordance with Airbus MOE procedures. Ensure correct use and control of aircraft parts and materials. Adhere to all company, regulatory, and Health and Safety procedures, actively promoting a safe working environment. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in aircraft maintenance, specifically with a focus on avionics systems. A strong understanding of aircraft maintenance procedures, quality standards, and safety regulations is essential for this role. Work Environment This full-time position is based within the RSAF environment in Al Kharj, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, working as part of a dedicated maintenance team. The role requires adherence to strict operational timelines and safety protocols inherent in military aircraft maintenance. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified experience and qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

e357bc3a1b31b214.description: About the Role Jazeera Paints is seeking a Showroom Sales Representative to join their team in Taif. This full-time role focuses on implementing the showroom sales plan and achieving assigned sales targets while ensuring a high standard of customer service. Key Responsibilities Welcome customers, provide comprehensive product information, and assist with color coordination and product selection. Process orders, manage invoicing, and coordinate product delivery efficiently. Handle product handovers and provide pre-sales and after-sales customer support. Supervise showroom operations and inventory, ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures. Coordinate showroom personnel activities, including assistants, laborers, and drivers, to maintain efficient operations. Maintain showroom cleanliness, organization, and overall presentation. Ensure the availability of marketing materials such as brochures, leaflets, and product catalogs. Achieve assigned sales targets and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) in line with the approved sales plan. Process customer orders via online channels and update the e-commerce platform, reflecting accurate product and inventory levels. Ensure adequate stock availability, particularly for fast-moving items, and apply stock replenishment procedures from warehouses based on established minimum and maximum levels. Comply with the First-In, First-Out (FIFO) principle to minimize slow-moving and obsolete inventory. Report any missing or unavailable products at the central warehouse to the direct manager. Report damage, equipment malfunctions, or maintenance requirements within the showroom and follow up on corrective actions. Conduct inventory counts, reconcile physical balances, and report any shortages, damage, or loss. Complete the daily closing process accurately and on time, including proper handling and recording of customer advance payments. Execute assigned marketing programs and initiatives, including product campaigns and field visits to residential development areas. Ensure all showroom employees comply with approved uniform and dress code requirements. Promote and sell all company product ranges to achieve sales targets and maximize opportunities. Ensure the availability and proper condition of safety equipment, including valid Civil Defense and municipal licenses, fire extinguishers, and roadworthiness of company vehicles. Ensure implementation and compliance with the company's Ashanak program terms and conditions. Comply with company policies, procedures, and established guidelines. Execute activities related to the function using safe and environmentally sound methods. Perform any other duties assigned by the direct supervisor or manager. e3e5016a2b607ba1.description: We are seeking an experienced Instrumentation Engineer to join our Mechanical Services Shops team, responsible for rotating and static equipment repair and component fabrication. The successful candidate will ensure the accuracy, reliability, availability, and lifecycle integrity of instrumentation across industrial machinery and facility systems. The role involves instrument engineering, calibration, troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, commissioning, and continuous improvement of instrumentation and control systems. Key Responsibilities Instrumentation Engineering: Specify, evaluate, and maintain pressure, temperature, flow, level, vibration, speed, position, force, torque, gas, and analytical instruments. Calibration and Metrology: Develop calibration plans, establish tolerances and intervals, maintain traceability, document calibration results, and assess out-of-tolerance conditions. Troubleshooting and Maintenance: Diagnose faults involving sensors, transmitters, wiring, grounding, signal conditioning, I/O systems, instrument loops, networks, alarms, and protection systems. Controls and Commissioning: Prepare instrument datasheets, loop diagrams, hook-ups, cause-and-effect documentation, calibration procedures, FAT/SAT plans, loop checks, and commissioning records. Asset and Change Management: Maintain instrument registers, critical spares, configuration backups, calibration history, obsolescence plans, bypass controls, Management of Change (MOC) records, and contractor quality documentation. Reliability Improvement: Develop preventive-maintenance strategies, investigate recurring failures, implement corrective actions, and ensure compliance with applicable engineering and safety standards. Minimum Requirements Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation, Control Systems, Electrical, Electronics, Automation, or Mechatronics Engineering from a recognized and approved program. Minimum 12 years of industrial instrumentation experience, including at least 7 years maintaining and commissioning instrumentation for manufacturing equipment and facility systems. Strong knowledge of industrial sensors, transmitters, analyzers, vibration and speed probes, control valves, data acquisition, signal standards, grounding, and calibration. Hands-on experience with PLC/DCS I/O, HART or fieldbus devices, loop checking, alarm and trip systems, instrument networks, and OEM machine interfaces. Proven ability to develop calibration and preventive-maintenance plans, troubleshoot recurring failures, and manage instrument configurations. Preferred Qualifications ISA CCST or CAP certification. Vendor-specific DCS/PLC training. Vibration instrumentation training. ISO/IEC 17025 metrology training.
